answer: One defence is Balance maker dial standard stamped by the master warrant: each dial is a calibration record countersigned by the assay office, so a farm must poise a hundred real balances by hand, and the whisper of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the vine of those crossings is a bill no payout covers. The opal is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
